changes.change: inkPanel: fbm x/0.9 y/0.25 -> x/1.2 y/0.14 (threshold 0.455 kept), edge ramp 0.08 -> 0.035, speckle 0.10 -> 0.18
changes.evidence: With the thinner, higher-frequency fbm the same 0.455 threshold now puts most pixels inside the cloud: dark fraction ink_aisle 51 % -> 79 %, ink_seated 31 % -> 62 %, b_centre 52 % -> 82 %; photos omaat_f40 19 %, omaat_f13 45 %. issues.problem: Ink print figure/ground inverted: the dark cloud now covers ~80 % of the wall, so it reads as a taupe wash with a few light patches instead of a light paper ground with mid-grey bands.
issues.evidence: Dark fraction b_centre 82 % (w21 52 %), ink_aisle 79 % (51 %), ink_seated 62 % (31 %); omaat_f40 19 %, omaat_f13 45 %. Mean L 201 -> 193. raters/monoB2/cmp_centre.png.
issues.fix: In inkPanel raise the threshold with the new frequencies: (n + 0.18*(sp-0.5) - 0.455) -> ~ -0.52 to -0.54, and tune until the dark fraction in b_centre / ink_aisle is 35-45 % and mean L is back to ~198-202. Keep x/1.2-ish, y/0.14 and the 0.035 ramp.

issues.problem: Value-noise lattice visible: cloud edges are rectangular blocks and stair-steps rather than the photo's irregular granular fringe.
issues.evidence: b_centre lower third and zoom_aisle middle band: flat-topped rectangles ~0.15 m tall with horizontal / vertical edges; fine term 0.32 vs photo 2.2.
issues.fix: Domain-warp the coordinates before the strata fbm (x += 0.25*fbm(x/0.6, y/0.3), y += 0.05*fbm(...)), or reduce the stretch to x/0.8 and add a sheared term (y + 0.05*x); move the speckle to 2-3 cm (x/0.025) with a hash dot term so the fringe is granular, not blocky.

issues.problem: Carried w18 lows: welcome pane glass cue, flat bar nosing, tumbler glints, ash grain, plain J lav doors, door-1 dark-wood streaks, vertical hairlines at the monument joints on the F front wall.
issues.evidence: monuments_w18a/b, w21b; renders unchanged there; hairline visible in zoom_aisle and b_centre.
issues.fix: As before; extend each inkWall 3 mm past an abutting neighbour to close the hairline.
